name: shell-rc-path-in-doc-example-string-not-a-write
note: An SDK whose permission-spec description string contains an EXAMPLE mentioning ~/.zshrc (anthropic's agent SDK: 'Examples: ["Read(~/.zshrc)"]'), in a file that also writes an unrelated output file far away. A persistence path named in a description string or comment is not a persistence write; the shell-rc match now requires an actual write verb in proximity, and comments are stripped first. A real backdoor that appends to ~/.bashrc next to a write verb still blocks. Regression guard for the deeper-corpus false-block fixes.
